thread:
Ava Martinez: FYI opened PR to add a short "SNI rewrite" troubleshooting section for Private installer. Includes Calico example, nftables/iptables quick fixes, and a tiny Rust SDK snippet. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4722

Rohan Singh: nice. Customers hit SNI rewrites a lot in air-gapped installs when sidecar proxies map kms.example -> hsm-gw:4731. can we show exact sidecar config and a minimal tcpdump pattern to confirm SNI rewrite?

Ava Martinez: added sidecar sample and tcpdump check. snippet:```yaml
proxy:
  rewrite_sni: true
  rewrite_map:
    "kms.example": "hsm-gw:4731"
  keepalive: 30s
```

Ava Martinez: tcpdump quickcheck:```bash
tcpdump -i any -s 0 -A 'tcp port 4731' | grep -i 'Server Name'
```

Claire Park: include a WARN block: enabling rewrite_sni can break certificate validation if sidecar doesn't preserve original CN. add short fix: configure sidecar to send original SNI on upstream TLS or update sidecar TLS validation to trust new cert.

Rohan Singh: add conntrack note: NAT devices often drop idle HSM sessions. recommend setting keepalive and increasing nf_conntrack hashsize or timeout. short sysctl example please.

Ava Martinez: added sysctl examples: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=432000`. also added note about staggering sidecar restarts during gateway cutovers.

Claire Park: for Calico, prefer GlobalNetworkPolicy example using labels instead of raw IPs. small example in PR?

Ava Martinez: yes:```yaml
apiVersion: projectcalico.org/v3
kind: GlobalNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-hsm-egress
spec:
  selector: role == 'private-node'
  egress:
  - action: Allow
    protocol: TCP
    destination:
      nets: ['10.10.0.0/24']
      ports: [4731]
  order: 90
```

Rohan Singh: can we add nftables and iptables one-liners for quick ops triage? keep them minimal.

Ava Martinez: added one-liners:
- iptables: `iptables -I OUTPUT -p tcp -d 10.10.0.5 --dport 4731 -j ACCEPT`
- nftables: `nft add rule ip filter output tcp dport 4731 ip daddr 10.10.0.5 accept`

Claire Park: SDK snippets — existing docs have python/go/java. let's add a minimal Rust example so we vary language coverage in docs. show base_url to sidecar.

Ava Martinez: Rust snippet added under "SDK snippets":```rust
use redwood::Client;
fn main() {
  let client = Client::new("REDACTED", "http://127.0.0.1:8080");
  let resp = client.generate("hello").unwrap();
  println!("{}", resp.text);
}
```

docs-lint-bot: ERROR: broken internal link in PR 4722 -> /private/network/egress-proxy. Please update to /private/vpc/egress-proxy.

Ava Martinez: thanks bot. updated cross-links and added a redirect note. also added migration checklist: 1) update policies to allow new gateway; 2) deploy sidecar config with keepalive and SNI settings; 3) rotate sidecar certs if needed; 4) stagger restarts; 5) monitor TLS handshake errors via logs.

Rohan Singh: add a tiny Loki query example to surface SNI/cert mismatch logs during rollout.

Ava Martinez: added query: `|~ "certificate" or |~ "tls handshake"` under observability. also added WARN: never disable TLS verification in prod; only use tls_verify=false temporarily for isolated testing.

ops-alert-bot: INFO: staging docs deploy scheduled after merge.

Claire Park: I'll review wording tomorrow morning. please add a short line reminding customers to update any iptables that referenced old gateway IP after migration.

Ava Martinez: added that final note. merging after Claire's quick pass. will open follow-up thread if support sees post-release SNI tickets. :shipit:
